principle: No religion · No finance · No gatekeeping

support.heading: Support the archive
support.message: 21st Memory is free for everyone, always — no paywalls, no memberships, no pressure. Support can take many forms: sharing a topic, inviting someone into the work, joining the community, or contributing if you choose. Financial contributions help cover the operating costs of the archive — AI tools used to organize and decode transmissions, internet and power, hosting, and the infrastructure that keeps this work freely available. Every form of support helps the archive reach more people.
